key_insight: WorldCrafter introduces a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory so a video world model can remember what it has seen and re-use that evidence from new viewpoints. In simple terms, the requested viewpoint helps decide how past multi-view observations are compressed into the model’s limited memory.
problem_solved: Video world models often lose consistency over long rollouts and when the camera changes view, causing them to forget prior observations or hallucinate conflicting scene details.
method: Learns an implicit 3D-aware memory that can be queried by camera pose/viewpoint.
Uses the requested viewpoint to guide how multi-view evidence is compressed into a limited token budget for generation.
Trains the memory encoder, pose-conditioned memory, and video generator jointly to improve long-horizon and cross-view consistency.
impact: This makes video world models more reliable for interactive simulation, embodied AI, and view-consistent scene generation. For practitioners, it offers a path toward fewer hallucinations and better temporal/spatial coherence in generated environments.

paper_title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
paper_authors: Wangbo Yu, Kunhao Liu, Wenbo Hu, Shenghai Yuan, Chaoran Feng
